Functions $f$ and $g$ are graphed.

The set starts at (negative 4, 4), moves horizontally to the right to (negative 2, 4), moves downward to (2, 0), moves upward and ends at (4, 4).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/04fa425e84a2c87665cf40b95ec14e09639bfba8) ![Function g is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, negative 2), moves upward to (negative 1, 4), moves downward to (0, 1), moves upward through an open circle at (2, 3), and ends at (4, 5).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/5790a7c07d11038045950922dfb4d2f7fc47f8f4)

**Find $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to 2}\Big(f(x)-g(x)\Big)$.**
